task_metadata.research_topic: efficient sampling algorithms for text-to-image latent diffusion models
task_metadata.research_question: How can a sampler update rule improve text-image alignment at a fixed NFE=20 budget on Stable Diffusion-family models?
notes: The task description emphasizes CLIP score, while the shipped evaluator also reports FID against COCO val2014 statistics.
Stable Diffusion v2.0 base does not have a separate canonical paper in task-local metadata, so the latent diffusion paper is used as the architectural reference for the sd20 test.

tests.label: sd15
tests.notes: SD v1.5 evaluation uses a latent diffusion backbone, COCO-style prompts, CLIP score, and FID.

tests.label: sd20
tests.notes: The sd20 test evaluates Stable Diffusion 2.0 base under the same COCO, CLIP-score, and FID protocol; the latent diffusion paper is the closest canonical architecture reference.

tests.label: sdxl
tests.notes: The SDXL test links directly to the SDXL paper and uses the same COCO, CLIP-score, and FID evaluation protocol.

baselines.name: ddim
baselines.notes: Maps directly to the DDIM sampler baseline.

baselines.name: dpm2m
baselines.notes: Maps to the multistep DPM-Solver++ / DPM++ 2M family described in the DPM-Solver++ paper.

baselines.name: dpm2s
baselines.notes: Maps to the singlestep second-order DPM-Solver++ / DPM++ 2S family described in the DPM-Solver++ paper.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Foundational diffusion paper underlying DDIM, DPM-Solver++, and later latent diffusion samplers.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.relevance: Introduces the DDIM baseline used directly in this task.

papers.title: DPM-Solver++: Fast Solver for Guided Sampling of Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Primary paper for the DPM++ baseline family used by both dpm2m and dpm2s.
